text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning many races
alongside Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly remember that I once won
a hot springs voucher from the lottery.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, no, but...
I-Is it really okay for me to use it...?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Still, winning a hot spring trip in a l-lottery...
It makes me so happy, it's almost scary in a way..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, if it's alright with you, Trainer,
would you like to come along too...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If Trainer is with me,
um, it makes me feel a bit more at ease, or, well...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaaa~...! Amazing, we made it on time!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm always taking the wrong path or the wrong train,
so I hardly ever arrive without trouble~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That's because Trainer checked the map and the timetable for us. Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —Bahya!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-Waaah...! Is it really okay for me
to eat such wonderful food?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...!
Th-Th-Thank you for the food~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~~...gh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a burning smell drifted over.
Looking closely, the flame from the solid fuel burner
had caught onto Meisho Doto's chopsticks—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm so sorry~...!
When we came all the way out on a trip, too...!
choice_data_list: I'm glad it didn't turn into anything serious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since we're on a hot spring trip,
let's clear our heads in a nice bath.
When I suggested that—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You're right, since we're on a hot springs trip and all.
It'd be so nice... if I could just relax
in the warm water~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, that bath felt so nice~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I tripped over a washbasin...
and lost my locker key, but still."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Still, I feel nice and toasty warm...♪ Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um... it looks like there's going to be
a meteor shower today...! I saw it on the news the other day.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So, I actually looked up some nice spots around here.
And, well, if you'd like... would you want to go?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me...!
I-I got totally lost~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If I turn right at the big pine tree, the sea should be there...
But for some reason, I'm going deeper into the woods...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame about the meteor shower, but...
wandering too far from the inn might be dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh... Um, could I have just a little more time,
please? Just a tiny bit longer...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-If you start to get tired,
I can give you a piggyback ride...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I politely declined the piggyback,
and after walking for a few more hours—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-We're hereee~! Wow, the scenery is
truly gorgeous~! A whole sky full of stars...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Stars... I wonder if a shooting star will pass if we wait.
Um, I'm sorry for asking so many times...
Can we stay just a little bit longer...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...!
Ehehe, thank you so much~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us ended up waiting
awhile for the meteor shower to start.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "...I'm really glad I asked you to come along after all, Trainer~."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't been there, Trainer,
I definitely would've ended up feeling way more down.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "All I did was get worked up and lost, even though it was supposed to be a special hot springs trip."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
…………
...And that goes for the Twinkle Series too, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't been there for me, Trainer,
I definitely would have felt even more down—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's why all I end up doing
is praising everyone else for how amazing they are...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I feel like... I wasn't even able
to take that first step...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, you're amazing, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Before I could say anything,
Meisho Doto let out a cheer."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! S-S-Shooting stars!
It's a meteor shower-r-r!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking up,
countless shooting stars were streaking across the sky.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Amazing... I really got to see it with my own eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...! Trainer-san.
Are you feeling happy right now...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-Was I able... to give you...
a truly wonderful feeling...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Th-Thank goodness~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, well... I caused you so, so much trouble, so I wanted to thank you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems that was why she did research beforehand, which was rare for her, and insisted so stubbornly on seeing the meteor shower.
choice_data_list: Thank you, that makes me really happy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! ...What a relief.
I'm so glad~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of us enjoyed the meteor shower...
And even though on the way back we got lost
and fell into a river while being chased by a deer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Meisho Doto...
